metadata.description: Primary standards and practical tools for docs-as-code, OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documentation, AI-readable docs, cross-platform instruction files, and documentation quality checks.
metadata.title: Docs Codebase - Sources

style_guides_and_writing.name: Google Developer Documentation Style Guide
style_guides_and_writing.relevance: Practical, widely used style guide for clear technical writing.

style_guides_and_writing.name: Microsoft Writing Style Guide
style_guides_and_writing.relevance: Modern technical writing guidance with examples and conventions.

style_guides_and_writing.name: Diataxis Framework
style_guides_and_writing.relevance: Information architecture model for tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation docs.

style_guides_and_writing.name: blader/humanizer
style_guides_and_writing.relevance: Source taxonomy for AI-writing tells (elegant variation, copula avoidance, negative parallelisms, false ranges, knowledge-cutoff disclaimers, etc.) adapted into writing-best-practices.md's AI-Writing Tells section. Pinned at commit 523374dee72d67c7b2b5f858ea0094ffda49c3ac (MIT license), extracted 2026-08-09.

markdown_and_content_standards.name: CommonMark Specification
markdown_and_content_standards.relevance: Reference Markdown spec to reduce renderer inconsistencies.

markdown_and_content_standards.name: Keep a Changelog

api_documentation_and_specs.name: AsyncAPI Specification v3.1.0

docs_quality_and_ci.name: markdown-link-check
docs_quality_and_ci.relevance: Automated link checking for docs to prevent broken navigation.

docs_quality_and_ci.name: cspell
docs_quality_and_ci.relevance: Spell checking for docs and codebases with custom dictionaries.

docs_quality_and_ci.name: Redocly CLI
docs_quality_and_ci.relevance: API linting, bundling, and governance checks for OpenAPI and related specifications.

accessibility.name: WCAG 3.0 Working Draft
